title: St. George's Cathedral, Cape Town
geometryBasis: Named 47-vertex cathedral polygon, Mike Hayes’s exact 2006 original, and the cathedral’s own account of its construction.
sectionBasis: Steep red tiled nave and crossing roofs, a paired Wale Street porch below the recessed and traceried north transept window, pointed stone clerestory bays and stepped buttresses.
limitations: The model represents the named cathedral as seen in its 2006 Wale Street photograph. The projecting transept, twin entrance porch, tracery and buttresses are modeled directly from the published visual reference.
Roof heights and unphotographed south and chancel details use estimates. The lower exterior uses the modern mapped outline and original terrain.
Stone courses and leaded tracery are simplified at exterior viewing scale. The crypt and other interior spaces are outside this model.
